questions.question: A claims application must store the same fields, including a damage type chosen from four values, for every uploaded photo. Which solution meets the requirement?

options.text: A custom Content Understanding analyzer based on the image analyzer with a classify field
options.why: Correct. A field schema returns the same structure for every file.

options.text: An image generation request with n set to 4
options.why: The n setting controls the number of generated images.

options.text: A gpt-image deployment with a mask
options.why: Image generation does not analyze uploaded photos.

options.text: A chat completion that asks for a description in free text
options.why: Free text does not guarantee the same fields.

questions.explanation: A custom analyzer with a field schema returns typed fields each time. The classify method picks a value from a list that you define.

questions.question: A developer defines a field in a custom image analyzer by using the extract method and receives a validation error. What should the developer use instead?

options.text: The extract method with a higher confidence threshold
options.why: The error is not caused by a confidence threshold.

options.text: The estimate method
options.why: No such field method exists.

options.text: The generate or classify method
options.why: Correct. Extract is meant for values written in documents. Images use generate or classify.

options.text: A video analyzer as the base
options.why: This changes the content type but does not make extract valid for images.

questions.explanation: For images and video, use generate (free text from understanding) or classify (a value from your list). Extract is for documents.

questions.question: A training department has a 12-minute video. A search application must jump to the section about forklift safety. Which configuration enables this?

options.text: A video analyzer with segmentation enabled and a description of how to split the video
options.why: Correct. Each segment returns its own fields, key frames and transcript.

options.text: A video analyzer with segmentation disabled
options.why: With segmentation disabled the whole video is one segment.

options.text: An image analyzer applied to the file
options.why: An image analyzer does not process video.

options.text: A gpt-image deployment
options.why: Image generation creates pictures and does not analyze video.

questions.explanation: Segmentation divides video into scenes by using your category descriptions. Each segment has its own results, which enables search by section.

questions.question: An analyst compares a standard Content Understanding analyzer with pro mode. Which statement correctly describes the difference?

options.text: Standard mode does not return confidence scores
options.why: Standard analyzers return structured fields.

options.text: Pro mode removes the need for an analyzer
options.why: Pro mode still uses an analyzer definition.

options.text: Standard mode applies a single analysis task to the input to produce fields, and pro mode adds reasoning across inputs and reference data
options.why: Correct. Pro mode targets multi-step reasoning and validation scenarios.

options.text: Pro mode runs only on-premises
options.why: Both modes are cloud capabilities of the service.

questions.explanation: Single-task analyzers produce fields from the input. Pro mode adds multi-step reasoning, which can use several inputs and reference data. Check Microsoft Learn for the content types that currently support it.

questions.question: An application must identify where in a photograph the damaged area appears and show the location to a reviewer. The location does not need to be exact. Which approach is appropriate?

options.text: Generate a new image with a red circle
options.why: Image generation changes the picture and does not locate the damage in the original.

options.text: Use a larger value of n in the image API
options.why: The n parameter controls the number of generated images.

options.text: Ask a multimodal model to return the object label and a bounding box, then let a person confirm it
options.why: Correct. Model-returned boxes are approximate, so a reviewer confirms them.

options.text: Use the extract method on a photo analyzer
options.why: Extract is for documents.

questions.explanation: Region identification from a language model returns approximate boxes. Present them to a person, or define fields that describe the objects when repeatable output is needed.
